articles.title: Voice AI engine and OpenAI partner LiveKit hits $1B valuation
articles.summary: The five-year-old-startup powers OpenAI’s ChatGPT voice mode and raised a $100 million round led by Index Ventures.

articles.title: Inference startup Inferact lands $150M to commercialize vLLM
articles.summary: The seed round values the newly formed startup at $800 million.

articles.title: Are AI agents ready for the workplace? A new benchmark raises doubts
articles.summary: New research looks at how leading AI models hold up doing actual white-collar work tasks, drawn from consulting, investment banking, and law. Most models failed.

articles.title: Google DeepMind CEO is ‘surprised’ OpenAI is rushing forward with ads in ChatGPT
articles.summary: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis says the tech giant isn't pressuring him to insert ads into the AI chatbot experience.

articles.title: Humans& thinks coordination is the next frontier for AI, and they’re building a model to prove it
articles.summary: Humans&, a new startup founded by alumni of Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, xAI, and Google DeepMind, is building the next generation of foundation models for collaboration, not chat.

articles.title: Google now offers free SAT practice exams, powered by Gemini
articles.summary: Students can prompt Gemini by typing "I want to take a practice SAT test,” and the AI will provide them with a free practice exam. Gemini then analyzes the results, highlighting strengths and identifying areas that need further review. It also offers detailed explanations for any incorrect answers.

articles.title: Google’s AI Mode can now tap into your Gmail and Photos to provide tailored responses
articles.summary: The company notes that AI Mode doesn’t train directly on your Gmail inbox or Google Photos library. Instead, it trains on specific prompts and the model’s responses.

articles.title: Google snags team behind AI voice startup Hume AI
articles.summary: Google has hired the CEO and top engineer behind voice AI startup Hume AI, signaling that voice is increasingly becoming the preferred interface over screens.

articles.title: From invisibility cloaks to AI chips: Neurophos raises $110M to build tiny optical processors for inferencing
articles.summary: Neurophos is taking a crack at solving the AI industry's power efficiency problem with an optical chip that uses a composite material to do the math required in AI inferencing tasks.

articles.title: Anthropic has to keep revising its technical interview test as Claude improves
articles.summary: The issue of AI cheating is already wreaking havoc at schools and universities around the world, so it's ironic that AI labs are having to deal with it too. But Anthropic is also uniquely well-equipped to deal with the problem.

articles.title: Spotify brings AI-powered Prompted Playlists to the US and Canada
articles.summary: Now available in the US and Canada, Spotify's AI-powered Prompted Playlists let users describe what they want to hear using natural language commands.

articles.title: Quadric rides the shift from cloud AI to on-device inference — and it’s paying off
articles.summary: Quadric aims to help companies and governments build programmable on-device AI chips that can run fast-changing models locally.

articles.title: Former Google trio is building an interactive AI-powered learning app for kids
articles.summary: Sparkli said that education systems often fall behind in teaching modern concepts. The company wants to teach kids about topics like skills design, financial literacy, and entrepreneurship by creating an AI-powered learning "expedition."

articles.title: Not to be outdone by OpenAI, Apple is reportedly developing an AI wearable
articles.summary: Should this wearable materialize, it could be released as early as 2027, according to a report on the device.

articles.title: Sources: Project SGLang spins out as RadixArk with $400M valuation as inference market explodes
articles.summary: SGLang, which originated as an open source research project at Ion Stoica’s UC Berkeley lab, has raised capital from Accel.

articles.title: A timeline of the US semiconductor market in 2025
articles.summary: From leadership changes at legacy semiconductor companies to wishy washy policy around chip exports, a lot happened last year.

articles.title: Todoist’s app now lets you add tasks to your to-do list by speaking to its AI
articles.summary: The feature, now public, lets you create to-do's and action items by speaking naturally to the app's AI.

articles.title: Apple plans to make Siri an AI chatbot, report says
articles.summary: Siri could look more like ChatGPT than its current state as an integrated feature across Apple products.

articles.title: Anthropic revises Claude’s ‘Constitution,’ and hints at chatbot consciousness
articles.summary: The newly revised document offers a roadmap for what Anthropic says is a safer and more helpful chatbot experience.

articles.title: Irony alert: Hallucinated citations found in papers from NeurIPS, the prestigious AI conference
articles.summary: Research from startup GPTZero points to the impossible problem prestigious conferences face in the age of AI slop.

articles.title: Applied Digital starts work on 430MW data center campus
articles.summary: Company vague, says campus in a “southern US state”

articles.title: Airedale launches new air-cooling chiller
articles.summary: Company says chillers still needed in era of warm-water cooling

articles.title: Cable theft leaves 2,500 properties in Lincolnshire, UK, with no Internet
articles.summary: Openreach engineers are working to restore services for those impacted

articles.title: Compute, storage, and networking: A 2025 retrospective
articles.summary: US manufacturing booms, Nvidia splashes the cash, and quantum machines advance

articles.title: All of the above - 2025 in energy and sustainability
articles.summary: With energy demand skyrocketing data centers have looked all over to secure power for their facilities

articles.title: Magyar Telekom begins migration of 2G customers to Yettel's networks
articles.summary: As the carrier pushes to focus on 4G/5G networks

articles.title: India-based AM Group could establish 1GW data center campus in northern India
articles.summary: Company claims campus will be online by 2030

articles.title: Masdar, Octopus sign MoUs to unlock UK grid capacity for data centers, expand clean energy in Africa
articles.summary: Will seek to identify underutilized capacity within distribution networks and develop on-site energy systems to support data center growth

articles.title: Pilot Energy to deploy gas flare data center module in Western Australia
articles.summary: Company partners with Kala Data

articles.title: Thailand's Gulf Edge signs deal with Google to access AI infrastructure
articles.summary: One day after Google launched its first cloud region in the country

articles.title: V.tal announces plans for US-Brazil submarine cable
articles.summary: New Synapse cable will have a branch in Fortaleza integrated with Tecto's Mega Lobster data center (TFOR3)

articles.title: Meta-backed geothermal firm Sage closes $97m funding round, announces first commercial facility
articles.summary: Plant set to be constructed at existing Ormat Technologies site

articles.title: Equinix launches data center in San Jose, California
articles.summary: First facility powered under a partnership between San Jose and PG&E

articles.title: SambaNova seeking $500m in funding after acquisition talks with Intel stall – report
articles.summary: Intel was reportedly mulling a $1.6bn acquisition of the AI solution provider as recently as last month

articles.title: US House Foreign Affairs Committee advances bill to give Congress AI chip export authority
articles.summary: Bipartisan legislation passed the House 42-2

articles.title: Telenor sells 30 percent stake in Thailand’s True Corporation to Arise Digital Technology
articles.summary: The sale will net Telenor $3.9 billion

articles.title: Humain and Infra set up $1.2bn financing package to fund 250MW of data center space in Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: Non-binding agreement to fund digital infrastructure projects

articles.title: Global Switch signs eight year PPA with RWE to power Docklands data center in London
articles.summary: Will offtake power from a onshore wind project in Wales

articles.title: Microsoft wins $170m cloud contract from US Air Force
articles.summary: Contract awarded as part of the Cloud One Program

articles.title: Exowatt launches business arm to deliver powered land and energy for hyperscale data centers
articles.summary: ExoRise will be underpinned by the company's solar + storage technology

articles.title: Can rising power demand boost renewables above policy obstacles in 2026?
articles.summary: The industry is navigating new FEOC rules and steeling itself for the end of some IRA credits. But load growth and rising electricity bills present opportunity.

articles.title: Acting CISA chief defends workforce cuts, declares agency ‘back on mission’
articles.summary: Madhu Gottumukkala said the Trump administration supports a long-term renewal of the 2015 Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Act. The agency is also working on finalizing regulation under the Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act.

articles.title: Massachusetts can make ‘bottom-up’ distribution reforms for a better grid
articles.summary: Adopting a distribution system operator, or DSO, structure would make the grid cleaner, more flexible and more affordable, writes Corrin Moss of the Massachusetts Clean Energy Center.

articles.title: Gas sector takes furnace efficiency fight to Supreme Court
articles.summary: Advocates say stricter efficiency rules can be met with proven, energy-saving technologies. The gas industry says the rules ban non-condensing furnaces and other products.

articles.title: PJM cost concerns bleed into transmission planning
articles.summary: A proposed $1.7-billion, 765-kV power line across central Pennsylvania by NextEra Energy and Exelon could become the “poster child” for overbuilding new transmission infrastructure, according to that state’s ratepayer advocate.

articles.title: Managed EV charging can save utilities and ratepayers money: report
articles.summary: By optimizing electric vehicle charging around peak times, utilities can delay costly distribution grid upgrades while cutting per-vehicle charging costs by 25% or more, Brattle Group said this month.

articles.title: Project finance is the missing link for the nuclear buildout we need
articles.summary: This model fuels nearly every major energy infrastructure investment and should be applied to nuclear, too, writes Ruhani Arya of Bank of America.

articles.title: Labor, tariffs collide with data center boom
articles.summary: Contractors report booming demand for certain types of builds, particularly data centers and power projects to support them. But outside those sectors, workforce shortages and tariffs weigh on construction.

articles.title: New Jersey governor orders state to accelerate solar, storage and virtual power plants
articles.summary: Gov. Mikie Sherrill, who was sworn in Tuesday, also ordered regulators to study how to “modernize” the traditional electric utility business model, including by making utility profits “less dependent on capital spending.”

articles.title: Google sees CO2 batteries as large-scale way to store renewable energy
articles.summary: The tech giant is working with a Milan-based company called Energy Dome, which has built a model facility in Ottana, Sardinia, Italy. As part of the partnership, Google has made an equity investment in the company.

articles.title: Argentina and Brazil MoU on maritime nuclear regulation
articles.summary: Argentina's Nuclear Regulatory Authority and Brazil's Naval Secretariat for Nuclear Safety and Quality aim to develop regulation relating to the use of nuclear reactors on ships.

articles.title: First mobile sorption unit launched by Rosatom
articles.summary: The construction and installation of the first mobile sorption unit at the Verkhne-Uksyanskaya deposit of the Dalmatovskoye uranium deposit is aimed at ensuring optimised uranium production, Rosatom says.

articles.title: Bulk sample programme begins at Tony M mine
articles.summary: The programme will see the extraction of up to 2000 tons of mineralised material to generate real-world mining, processing, and cost data, and is a "decision gate" towards a potential restart decision for IsoEnergy's past-producing uranium mine.

articles.title: Chinese tokamak achieves progress in high-density operation
articles.summary: Experiments at China's Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak have confirmed the existence of "a density-free region" of the tokamak, finding a method to break through the density limit and providing important physical evidence for the high-density operation of magnetic confinement fusion devices.

articles.title: Muroosystems expands nuclear cooperation in Central Asia
articles.summary: Japan's Muroosystems Corporation has signed a memorandum of understanding with UzAtom, Uzbekistan's nuclear development agency, for cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy. The focus of this cooperation is on nuclear safety, regulatory support, technical consulting, and owner's engineering services for nuclear projects.

articles.title: Slovakia selects Rothschild & Co to advise on new nuclear financing
articles.summary: The Slovak Republic has chosen Rothschild & Co after a competitive selection process for a financial advisor for its proposed new nuclear project.

articles.title: Meta announces 'landmark' agreements for new nuclear
articles.summary: Tech giant Meta says new agreements with Vistra, TerraPower, and Oklo will support up to 6.6 GW of new and existing capacity by 2035 and, together with last year's agreement with Constellation Energy, make it one of the most significant corporate purchasers of nuclear energy in US history.

articles.title: Akkuyu 2's turbine generator stator installed
articles.summary: The 437-tonne turbine generator stator was moved on a special track before being lifted into place in the turbine hall of unit 2 at Turkey's Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: In pictures: Second Hinkley Point C reactor vessel delivered to site
articles.summary: The Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant project in Somerset, England, has taken delivery of the reactor pressure vessel for its second EPR unit.

articles.title: Nuclear at heart of Kazakh plans says president
articles.summary: Nuclear energy is at the heart of Kazakhstan's strategic plans as it transitions to become a "digital power", the country's president has said in an interview with a national newspaper. Separately, the USA and Kazakhstan announced an expansion of their civil nuclear energy partnership with the launch of an SMR feasibility study.

articles.title: Agreements for potential deployment of NANO microreactors
articles.summary: US energy infrastructure solutions provider Ameresco Inc has signed a memorandum of understanding with NANO Nuclear Energy Inc to explore the potential deployment of micromodular reactors on federal and commercial sites. Meanwhile, DS Danseok has signed an MoU with NANO for the deployment of its microreactors in South Korea.

articles.title: US enrichment funding recipients flesh out plans
articles.summary: The companies selected to receive nearly USD3 billion in federal funding to strengthen US uranium enrichment services over the next decade have set out details of how and where they intend to deploy the funding, which will support thousands of jobs as well as building the domestic nuclear supply chain.

articles.title: Zeeland study looks at potential for SMRs
articles.summary: Small modular reactors could complement offshore wind and proposed large-scale nuclear power units in the Netherlands, a study commissioned by the Province of Zeeland says.

articles.title: Hinkley Point B plant declared free of fuel
articles.summary: The UK's Office for Nuclear Regulation has granted the Hinkley Point B nuclear power plant in Somerset Fuel Free Verification status, confirming all nuclear fuel has been removed on time and on budget and allowing the plant to move into its decommissioning phase.

articles.title: Fortum deepens cooperation with Steady Energy
articles.summary: Finnish utility Fortum has signed a framework agreement with small modular reactor developer Steady Energy under which Fortum will support Steady Energy in planning its district heating reactor's operation and maintenance model. In addition, Fortum will invest in Steady Energy.

articles.title: Operating permit for very low-level waste disposal facility in Finland
articles.summary: An operating permit which is valid until 2095 has been issued by the Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority of Finland for a new disposal facility for very low-level radioactive waste at Olkiluoto, to be operated by Teollisuuden Voima Oyj.

articles.title: Impact assessment process begins for Canadian new-build
articles.summary: Ontario Power Generation has submitted the Initial Project Description for a new nuclear plant at Wesleyville near Port Hope, a regulatory milestone marking the first step in the impact assessment process.

articles.title: Helen creating subsidiary for nuclear project
articles.summary: Finnish energy firm Helen is establishing a wholly-owned subsidiary, Helen Ydinvoima Oy, to investigate the prerequisites for constructing nuclear power in Helsinki and to prepare the project for an investment decision.

articles.title: Arabelle turbines selected for Polish plant
articles.summary: EDF subsidiary Arabelle Solutions has been selected by Bechtel and Westinghouse to supply half-speed Arabelle steam turbine and generator sets for the three AP1000 units planned at Poland's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Tests confirm integrity of Deep Isolation disposal canister
articles.summary: US nuclear waste disposal company Deep Isolation says that a two-year research project that subjected its Universal Canister System to the kinds of conditions found thousands of feet below the surface has shown materials used in its fabrication perform reliably and remain resistant to corrosion over time.
